newsitem.title: SWEDEN: ASSIDOMAN SEES STRONG INVESTMENT THIS YR.
newsitem.headline: ASSIDOMAN SEES STRONG INVESTMENT THIS YR.

text.p: Swedish forestry group AssiDoman said on Tuesday that it could put more than eight billion crowns into investments this year with the possibility of another fairly large acquisition this autumn.
"Investments in total will be around seven billion crowns for the full year under decisions to date," AssiDoman's managing director Lennart Ahlgren told a news conference.
"But as we have another further large acquisition that we have our eyes on this could well go above eight billion crowns."
He had earlier estimated investments for 1997 at between five and eight billion crowns.
In the first half of the year AssiDoman invested 4.1 billion cronws in fixed assets including 2.4 billion crowns on company acquisitions.

AssiDoman on Tuesday posted a profit after financial items of 859 million crowns which was slightly over market expectations of 819 million crowns and 30 percent lower than last year's 1.23 billion crowns.
Its share price was seven crowns higher at 240 crowns at 0840 GMT.
